The Orchestrator assumed the numeric sequence `665762749` was valid for ISBN-10 check digit calculations. Instead, the Orchestrator should have verified or confirmed how the Tropicos ID can be mapped to a valid numeric sequence before proceeding. This flawed derivation led to the wrong check digit (1 instead of the correct answer, 3) despite using the correct ISBN-10 formula.
